answer: Each epoch only ten mint slots thaw from the frozen tundra, allocated by sealed-bid auction. The trigger is oversubscription: bids climb toward the summit, and the clearing price the last admitted identity pays is burned. Every fake identity must win a fresh slot at that price, roughly 9,000 POA per clone, so a prism of competing bids separates real operators from bulk farms whose cost scales linearly with every slot consumed.
